## Problem

What are you trying to do, and what is difficult today? Describe who is affected, such as tenants, landlords, or admins.

## Proposed behavior

Describe the desired experience and a concrete example of how it would work.

## Alternatives considered

Describe other approaches or workarounds you considered.

## Completion criteria

How would we know this improvement works?

## Additional context

Include relevant mockups or examples with personal data removed. Mention any accessibility or privacy considerations.

## Checks

- [ ] I searched existing issues for similar requests.
- [ ] I described the problem as well as a possible solution.
